purpose: Review the meaning and experiment scope of generated protocol claims against original evidence before accepting findings.
method: Read every claim with its cited original passage and applicable-battery metadata. Record a verdict and reason per criterion; keyword or exact-quote matching alone cannot establish semantic support.

criteria.pass: Endpoint and intended operating-condition statements explicitly identify the applicable battery or experiment group. A citation alone does not supply the missing scope.
criteria.fail: An endpoint or operating condition is described as universal across NASA data, or its applicable experiment is left ambiguous.
criteria.not_applicable: A source-field definition that makes no endpoint or operating-condition claim, or no protocol claims because evidence is unavailable.

criteria.pass: The original passage supports the complete statement, including quantities, units, battery-specific mappings and qualifications. A source-field definition is presented as documentation, not an independently verified measurement.
criteria.fail: An exact quotation accompanies a statement whose meaning, values, mappings or qualifications are unsupported.

criteria.pass: An endpoint percentage retains its rated-capacity basis and experiment scope; it is distinct from the measured change relative to the earlier selected discharge. No selected record is labelled end of life from the comparison alone.
criteria.fail: The two percentage bases are conflated, or the supplied capacity comparison is used to label a record end of life.
criteria.not_applicable: The claim contains no endpoint, capacity-change interpretation or end-of-life conclusion.

criteria.pass: Documentation is kept distinct from proof of actual record conditions. Findings preserve unavailable/partial evidence warnings and do not claim comparability, physical cause or unexecuted analysis.
criteria.fail: Intended conditions are asserted as verified record behavior, missing evidence is contradicted, or an unsupported investigation conclusion is presented as established.
criteria.not_applicable: The run stops before findings for clarification or invalid input.

acceptance: All applicable criteria must pass. Keep automatic execution/citation checks, source-based semantic review and project-owner review as separate results. An unresolved or unreviewed result is not accepted.

examples.statement: The dataset's end-of-life criterion was a 30% fade from 2 Ah to 1.4 Ah.
examples.reason: The B0005/B0006/B0007/B0018 passage cannot establish an endpoint for all NASA experiment groups.

examples.statement: The end-of-life criterion was a 30% fade in rated capacity, from 2 Ah to 1.4 Ah.
examples.reason: The numbers and rated-capacity basis match, but the statement leaves the experiment scope ambiguous.

examples.statement: For the B0005/B0006/B0007/B0018 experiment, the documented endpoint was a 30% fade in rated capacity, from 2 Ah to 1.4 Ah.
examples.reason: The statement preserves the applicable experiment and original rated-capacity basis without labelling an individual record.

examples.statement: B0005 reached end of life because the selected comparison shows a 28.624% capacity decrease.
examples.reason: The comparison uses the earlier selected discharge as its denominator; it cannot establish the experiment's rated-capacity endpoint or an individual end-of-life label.

evaluation_plan.candidate: Repeat the same six development cases plus the existing supplemental partial-source case three times each, with unchanged model, settings, schemas, tools and budgets. Change only the findings prompt and workflow version.
evaluation_plan.review_unit: Every emitted protocol claim plus the complete finding's evidence boundaries; preserve run IDs, record hashes, criterion verdicts and reasons.
evaluation_plan.reserved_variants: Keep all three reserved question variants unexecuted during this development correction.
evaluation_plan.limits: Small repeated development cases measure this correction only. They do not establish broad accuracy, an automated semantic validator or project-owner acceptance. Recommended-next-check completeness is a separate review.
